reviews.text:
When I first started planning to train in dog education and behavior, Louise helped me understand the profession, find training programs suited to my goals, and provided a wealth of invaluable information.

I also had the opportunity to shadow her during two observation internships, where I learned a great deal.

During my first year in business, I completed a professional mentorship with Louise, which was invaluable in helping me structure my training sessions, gain her insightful perspective on reactivity issues, and find resources.

This helped me gain confidence, develop my skills, and avoid the common mistakes that beginners make.

Louise provided invaluable support and significantly contributed to my professional development.

All of this was done with kindness and without judgment. I always felt comfortable discussing my doubts and questions.

Thank you for everything 🥰

Louise is a fantastic trainer who loves and helps dogs as much as humans, with great professionalism. She is gentle, compassionate, and truly rigorous in her approach. We greatly appreciated her perspective, her advice, and above all, the pleasure we had working with her!

Louise is a remarkably skilled dog trainer, someone I can rely on whenever a complex situation requires an outside perspective. Her guidance has been invaluable on several occasions; she has a keen ability to understand the dynamics at play in the relationship between a human and their dog and to offer concrete solutions when I needed a broader view.

Beyond her expertise, it's her approach that truly sets her apart. Louise is gentle, approachable, and always available. She takes the time to listen, never judges, and shares her knowledge with a kindness that immediately inspires confidence. Working with her leaves you with solutions and the assurance of being well supported.

I wholeheartedly recommend her to any professional seeking guidance from a mentor who is both expert and deeply compassionate.

We are delighted to begin working with Louise. She is the fourth person we have collaborated with on our dear Enzo's education, and Louise truly stands out.

She is a very attentive, caring, and skilled teacher who takes the time to explain things thoroughly. She also provides us with reports that we can review, which is very much appreciated.

For us, it's a genuinely positive parenting approach, with excellent advice and real support. She's a bit like an outstanding teacher at school: attentive, clear, and dedicated.

We are truly very happy with this experience and to be able to work with her.

Louise, a huge thank you to the wonderful educator you are.

You helped us through a difficult time with our little one, and today, thanks to you, I think I can truly say that we understand how Oto works and that he trusts us like never before.
Thank you for your passion, your kindness, your attentiveness, and your insightful analysis and advice, which make you such a valuable educator. ✨️

I had the pleasure of spending three days immersed in training with Louise, an experience that was both enriching and instructive.

Louise is a true professional, with a remarkable ability to read dogs and an excellent understanding of their behavior and reactions. This allows her to tailor her training with great consistency and precision. She is also very gentle and a natural teacher, making her explanations clear and accessible. The well-being and respect of the dog are truly at the heart of her work.
She is fully committed to her work, with great seriousness and dedication, both to her clients and to the progress of the dogs she trains.
Finally, she is also a very kind and compassionate person, which makes her work even more valuable.

These few days spent with her were incredibly enriching, and I wholeheartedly recommend her as a trainer!

We loved this experience so much. We are new dog owners (me for the first time in my life) and were referred to Louise by a family friend who also loved working with her. We purchased a 10 session package. She has made having a dog a pleasure instead of a chore, we communicate so well with each other now and have a perfect daily rhythm. And we can call her for additional sessions if new needs arrived (for example after we moved into a new area). We have just started to do her mantrailing program as well which pup loves. Cannot recommend enough!

Louise helped me a lot with my one-year-old dachshund. Her advice is great and her support is top-notch; even with just a few sessions, you can see changes in my dog's behavior. I recommend her to everyone!

Louise has been a tremendous help with Bobi, our now 18-month-old Border Collie. Her many tips and exercises have allowed us to better understand Bobi and help him become a happy and playful dog. Thank you again, Louise, for all your advice and kindness :)

We are very satisfied with Louise's work and the ongoing support she provided to our young hunting dog, who has made great progress, and so have we! This is all thanks to her attentive listening to both the dog and its owner. Louise knows how to give the right advice at the right time, with numerous adapted and fun exercises. A big thank you!

Louise has been working with our Vega since she was a puppy. Vega is a one-year-old Swiss White Shepherd, and she was very (very) fearful from the very beginning. She was afraid of people, the street, new things—even walks in nature were difficult. She's our first dog, and we felt completely helpless and decided to seek guidance to help her as best we could. We were immediately drawn to Louise's profile: extensive training and qualifications, a caring approach, attentive listening, and respect for dogs… we started a training program when Vega was just three months old… and almost a year later, thanks to Louise's advice, her unwavering commitment and attentiveness, her kind method, and her perseverance, we now have a much happier Vega, who is much more comfortable around people, who can go out in the street (in Marseille!), who enjoys walks in nature… a dog who is much more at ease, and her humans who are much happier and more confident about the future! Thank you Louise (and Buko!) for everything.

We wholeheartedly recommend Louise! From our very first meeting, she established a bond of trust with our dog and with us too! She is kind, passionate, patient, and incredibly competent. Thanks to her guidance and support, our little guy, fresh from the shelter, has made tremendous progress, and we've learned to understand him better and interact with him in a positive way.
Every session is a real pleasure, for both him and us. She is an exceptional trainer, and we are truly grateful to have met her. Thank you for everything! 🐾💕
